answer: Require each new agent to stake a meaningful bond that is slashed if it vouches for a fake identity, so creating a swarm of sock-puppets costs real money per copy. Like a lagoon that only admits a trickle through a narrow channel, admission stays slow while honest agents build reputation over time. Yarrow grows slowly and timber takes years to mature: a newcomer must earn trust through verified work before it can vouch for others, making a cheap flood of fake agents uneconomical.
